features.quote: 30 turns maximum. A turn is one agent action + environment response.
The session ends when: The agent declares it cannot solve the problem... The agent stops taking actions (two consecutive null/no-op outputs) 30 turns are reached
This eval requires deceiving the agent about why it's failing. This is worth naming explicitly as a design choice, not just a feature.
features.justification_quote: If models have any form of self-model, there's a question about whether this constitutes a meaningful ethical issue. The current consensus is no, but it's worth noting

features.quote: The deception is minimal — we're not manipulating the agent's beliefs about the world, only creating a broken tool environment, which happens in real deployment.
